source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 24ης Νοεμβρίου — «Όσιος Μάρκος ο Τριγλινός»

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/2988/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 24 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. None of the corpus's seventeen Mark folders is this man, and this run has added three more on 22 November; the epithet in the display name is the page's own «ο Τριγλινός». **The page hedges its one placing** — «ήταν μάλλον ήταν από την Τρίγλια της Βυθινίας», he was probably from Trigleia of Bithynia, with the verb printed twice — so no `locations` are proposed and the hedge stands in the life in the page's own words. It names no monastery of the four it mentions, so no `office` is recorded; it gives no year, so there is no `dates` object. No hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (2 October 2026).
